Quick bursts of damage on these enemies and we'll do just fine.|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 2 (Formerly, [[Headache Headquarters]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Streamer''' was a fast enemy that appeared in [[Headache Headquarters]], replacing the [[Speedy]]. Currently, it only appears when the [[Brain Rot]] modifier is activated in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, replacing every [[Speedy]] and [[Quick]] modern variant, or with its [[Logbooks|Logbook]]. It has a high amount of health and a rather fast speed. ==Appearance== The '''Streamer''' has dark skin, a realistic head and brown dreads. It wears a Manchester United jersey with Portugal national team shorts. It also has brown shoes. ==Headache Headquarters Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Headache Headquarters]] is listed instead. *Strong early-game towers like the [[Militant]], [[Golden Scout]] or [[Golden Cowboy]] are very effective here. **Towers with area of effect capabilities, like the [[Electroshocker]] or [[Mortar]], can also be useful here. *High DPS towers like the [[Minigunner]] can be quite effective against this. *Stunning/freezing towers like the [[Warden]], [[Cryomancer]], [[Tesla]] or [[Freezer]] can be effective at stopping them as it is quite fast. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1Speed.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} IshowCorpse.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Skibidi Tower Defense Simulator Episode 1 (TOILETS)|'''Streamer''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} StreamerIconIG.png|'''Streamer''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *This enemy is based on the popular streamer [[wp:IShowSpeed|IShowSpeed]] (Darren Jason Watkins Jr.). **The outfit that the '''Streamer''' wore is based on [[wp:Cristiano_Ronaldo|Cristiano Ronaldo]], one of [[wp:IShowSpeed|Speed]]'s icons. ***The shirt is from the Manchester United 2022-23 home kit, while the shorts are from the Portugal national team's 2021-22 home kit. ***The shoes are the Adidas Yeezy Foam Runner Stone Sage variant that Speed frequently wears. **The fact that this enemy replaced the [[Speedy]] was likely inspired by the fact that ''Speed'' is in his name. ==Update History== *'''1 April 2024''' -
